themes.name: Wishlist Navigation and Organization Friction
themes.definition: Shoppers struggle to manage, sort, and navigate large lists of saved items due to viewport resets, truncation bugs, and lack of folder or categorization tools. This causes saved items to become lost, buried, or overwhelming to review, preventing shoppers from finalizing their selection.
includes: Wishlist scroll position resets to the top after returning from a product detail page
Older wishlisted items disappear or silently truncate when new items are saved
Absence of folders, sub-lists, tags, or category filtering to organize saved outfits
Shortlist or cart items vanishing due to UI synchronization bugs
excludes: Product detail pages failing to load due to general app crashes
Items being unavailable due to actual merchant inventory depletion

themes.name: Visual and Material Representation Discrepancy
themes.definition: Shoppers are unable to gauge the true color, fabric weight, drape, and texture of a garment due to edited studio lighting, AI-rendered models, and limited angle shots. This creates fear of an 'expectation vs. reality' gap where the physical item will look cheap or different from the catalogue.
includes: Catalogue imagery heavily altered by studio lighting leading to color inaccuracy
AI-generated model imagery that obscures true garment fit and physical drape
Inability to discern fabric texture, thickness, transparency, or sheen from images
Lack of multiple angles showing how the clothing hangs in natural light
excludes: Missing text specifications such as garment length or fabric blend percentage
Fear of receiving a counterfeit replica instead of the branded item

themes.name: Absence of Customer Photo Reviews
themes.definition: Shoppers hesitate to commit to a saved item because the product page lacks authentic buyer reviews, ratings, and unedited real-world customer photos. Without visual proof from peers of various body shapes, shoppers lack the confidence to validate catalogue claims.
includes: Wishlisted items with zero customer reviews or text-only ratings
Absence of buyer-submitted try-on images showing real-world fit and fabric
Distrust in product ratings suspected of being fabricated or incentivized
Lack of customer feedback indicating whether an item shrunk or bled color after washing
excludes: Lack of standard brand-provided model measurement charts
Platform customer service responsiveness issues

themes.name: Cross-Brand Sizing Inconsistency and Fit Uncertainty
themes.definition: Shoppers hesitate to purchase saved apparel and footwear because sizing varies wildly across different brands, labels, and standard charts. The anxiety of receiving a garment that runs significantly smaller or larger than expected stops them from completing the order.
includes: Inconsistent fit where a shopper's standard size differs drastically between brands
Generic or contradictory size conversion charts that do not match the specific item
Uncertainty around whether apparel runs true-to-size, relaxed, or slim-fit
Footwear sizing discrepancies between UK, US, and Euro measurement standards
excludes: Inability to exchange an item for a different size due to stockouts
Missing technical measurements like inseam or rise specifications

themes.name: Inadequate Garment Measurements and Technical Specs
themes.definition: Product pages lack essential physical dimensions and detailed material compositions, leaving shoppers unable to verify if an item meets their functional requirements. This forces shoppers to abandon the item or look outside the app for basic garment information.
includes: Missing key garment dimensions such as exact length, waist rise, sleeve length, or heel height
Vague fabric descriptions lacking exact percentage breakdowns (e.g., poly-blend vs. 100% cotton)
Absence of details regarding garment stretch, lining, opacity, or pocket availability
Missing model height and sizing references on the product detail page
excludes: Color mismatch caused by edited studio photography
Subjective fit variations across different fashion brands

themes.name: Chronic Size Stockouts and Ghost Inventory
themes.definition: Shoppers shortlist items only to find that popular or standard sizes are perpetually out of stock, falsely displayed as available, or unavailable in extended size ranges. This dead-ends the buying journey without offering reliable restock notifications or cart reservations.
includes: Saved items displaying the user's required size as chronically out of stock
Items shown as available in the wishlist that turn out out of stock when added to bag
Absence of back-in-stock alerts or size availability notifications
Exclusion of standard plus or petite sizes in popular wishlist catalogue lines
excludes: Delivery unserviceability caused by pincode or warehouse restrictions
Checkout drop-off caused by unexpected convenience fees

themes.name: Late Pincode Serviceability and Delivery Restrictions
themes.definition: Shoppers evaluate and save items only to discover late during checkout that delivery is disabled for their specific pincode. The lack of upfront location-based availability filters creates frustration and prevents order placement.
includes: Items showing as purchasable in the wishlist but marked unserviceable at bag or checkout
Absence of location-based inventory filters while browsing saved items
Vague or sudden delivery error messages tied to regional logistics coverage
Specific color or size variants being restricted to certain delivery zones
excludes: General courier transit delays after an order has already shipped
Delivery personnel behavior during doorstep package handovers

themes.name: Doubts on Authenticity and Garment Condition
themes.definition: Shoppers hold back from purchasing branded or heavily discounted fashion out of fear of receiving counterfeit items, replicas, or previously returned used garments. The lack of verified seller provenance undermines shopper trust in high-ticket or premium items.
includes: Suspicion that deeply discounted branded apparel consists of replicas or first copies
Apprehension about receiving items with missing original tags or broken security seals
Fear that delivered goods may be used, stained, or altered returns from other buyers
Distrust in unverified third-party sellers listed on the marketplace
excludes: Garment quality issues arising from poor fabric choices by legitimate brands
Studio lighting discrepancies between catalog images and real products

themes.name: Doorstep Return Rejection and Reverse-QC Anxiety
themes.definition: Shoppers hesitate to purchase sizing-sensitive or expensive items out of fear that pickup agents will refuse returns during doorstep quality checks. The risk of being stuck with a wrong, defective, or untagged item due to rigid verification rules deters order commitment.
includes: Fear of pickup agents rejecting return requests over minor tag, fold, or packaging discrepancies
Deadlocks where an incorrect or tagless item sent by the seller cannot be returned
Burdensome photo-proof requirements and automated rejections of legitimate return claims
Anxiety over disputes with customer support when reverse logistics agents fail verification
excludes: Items explicitly categorized upfront as non-returnable under category policy
Non-refundable platform fees deducted on checkout

themes.name: Hidden Non-Returnable and Restrictive Exchange Policies
themes.definition: Shoppers discover that saved fashion pieces or accessories are marked with strict 'no return', 'exchange only', or short-window policies. This inflexibility prevents purchase because shoppers cannot safely test garment fit and suitability at home.
includes: Surprise non-returnable or final-sale tags on fit-sensitive apparel categories
Items silently restricted to exchange-only, preventing full refunds if unsuitable
Overly short return or exchange validity windows that create checkout hesitation
Ambiguous return eligibility terms that are difficult to locate on the product detail page
excludes: Logistics agents failing to collect a pre-approved return at the doorstep
Platform convenience fees deducted during order settlement

themes.name: Size Exchange Inventory and Logistics Bottlenecks
themes.definition: Shoppers hesitate to buy fitted garments because direct size exchanges are often blocked by out-of-stock replacement sizes or pincode limitations. The prospect of having to go through a risky return-and-reorder process makes shoppers abandon the initial purchase.
includes: Inability to request an exchange because adjacent sizes are out of stock
Direct size exchanges disabled for the shopper's delivery pincode
Friction requiring full return, refund wait, and re-ordering at an altered price point
Lack of seamless exchange reservation tooling for size swaps
excludes: Initial uncertainty regarding brand sizing guides before placing an order
Non-returnable policy classifications on personal care or innerwear

themes.name: Unexpected Surcharges and Non-Refundable Platform Fees
themes.definition: Shoppers abandon their saved items at final checkout when unannounced platform fees, convenience charges, or non-refundable return penalties are added to the total. These fees increase the financial risk of trying on clothes that might need to be returned.
includes: Mandatory non-refundable convenience or platform fees added at the final checkout step
Return processing fees deducted from refunds even when items are defective or misdescribed
COD handling surcharges that inflate the advertised wishlist price
Lack of transparent breakdown of added fees before entering the payment gateway
excludes: General item price inflation or seasonal discount rollbacks
Payment gateway OTP failures or bank server downtime

themes.name: Anticipation of Fulfillment Errors and Dispute Friction
themes.definition: Shoppers hesitate to proceed with purchases due to apprehension that warehouse fulfillment will dispatch the wrong size, color, or style. Past experiences with unilateral order cancellations and unhelpful dispute resolution create purchase paralysis.
includes: Fear that warehouse packing will send a completely different color, pattern, or size
Anxiety that orders will be unilaterally cancelled post-confirmation due to inventory errors
Erosion of confidence in customer support channels resolving fulfillment mistakes
False delivery mark notifications where parcels are misreported as delivered
excludes: Courier delivery speed complaints on in-transit parcels
Strict doorstep return verification procedures conducted by logistics agents
